pages.text: Every biome hides unique aquatic life:$(br)$(br)• $(l)Desert$(): Sand Gliders & Pharaoh Bass.$(br)• $(l)Ice$(): Icicle Pikes & Absolute Zero.$(br)• $(l)Jungle$(): Piranha Kings & Canopy Spirits.$(br)• $(l)Swamp$(): Toxic Puffers, Eels, & Hydra Serpents.$(br)• $(l)Mushroom$(): Spore Minnows, Mycelium Carps, & Fungal Leviathans.
$(l)Rarity & Value$()$(br)$(br)The rarer and stronger the fish, the harder the minigame to catch it. However, the reward is worth it — high selling prices at the merchant!
